t:
Which of the following hazard is not associated with a hydro electrical power plant during construction phase?

I. Mechanical/electrical breakdown
II. Explosion or collapse of boilers
III. Fires in cable galleries, switching rooms, transformers, etc.
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
As per 'Hydrocarbon Endorsement For Testing & Commissioning' Article 2, after introduction of hydrocarbon / feedstock into the plant, the company shall not be liable for the loss or damage to:

I. Catalyst unless specifically endorsed separately
II. Reforming units due to overheating or cracking of any tubes
III. The insured plant due to overheating or cracking following an exothermic reaction
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a CPM policy, ______________ should be disposed of, preferably on "as is, where is" basis, at the best available prices in order to minimise the loss to a certain extent at the time of claim.
o: Losses discovered at the time of taking inventory
e: Correct answer: Salvage materials (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a machinery insurance policy, the sum insured represents the current market value. Argue. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: The sum insured represents the new replacement value of the items insured
The sum insured represents the depreciated value o
e: Correct answer: The sum insured represents the new replacement value of the items insured (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following supplementary covers are available in an Erection All Risk (EAR) policy on demand?

I. Cost incurred in the clearance and removal of debris of the insured property following a loss
II. A provision for escalation in value to take care of inflationary trends
III. Additional expenses incurred for air freight in connection with loss indemnifiable under the policy
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the general exclusions in a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy.

I. Loss or damage due to radioactive contamination
II. Loss resulting from experiments or overload
III. Loss or damage due to wilful negligence
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Identify the odd one out.
e: Correct answer: Electronic Equipment insurance (EEI) (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are special exclusions in a Comprehensive project (CP) insurance?

I. Crops, forests and cultures
II. Construction of dams and water reservoirs
III. Removal of debris
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Under a boiler and pressure plant insurance policy, what is the position of sum insured for the remainder of period after a claim is made?
o: Sum insurance is reduced by the amount claim made
Sum insurance is reduced by the amount of compensation
Sum insurance is increased by the amount of compen
Sum insurance is reduced by a deductible of 25%
e: Correct answer: Sum insurance is reduced by the amount of compensation (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In which of the reinsurance agreements is the premium and loss shared by the reinsurer in the same proportion?

I. Facultative
II. Surplus share treaty
III. Surplus treaty
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: What was the main purpose of the Steam Boiler Assurance Company when it was established in 1858?
o: Inspection and revision of steam engines and boile
Providing insurance coverage to steam engines and
Maintenance of steam engines and boilers
Providing reinsurance coverage to steam engines an boilers
Providing safety norms for steam engines and boile
e: Correct answer: Providing reinsurance coverage to steam engines an boilers (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Identify the hazards associated to steam turbines.
o: Explosion due to internal pressure and collapse
Complete disruption of the entire turbine due to centrifugal forces
Cracking of cylinder heads and seizure of pistons
Risk of toppling over due to overloading, storm, u
e: Correct answer: Complete disruption of the entire turbine due to centrifugal forces (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In which year was the "Manchester Steam Users Association (M.S.U.A.)" was founded?
e: Correct answer: 1854 (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the examples of plant, machinery and equipment commonly used in industries?

I. Boilers and associated equipment
II. Electrical plant and machinery
III. Patent
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
ABC Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses are general exclusions as per a CPM insurance policy?

I. Damages due to fire on site
II. Damages due to accidental falling of cement mixer
III. Damages due wilful negligence of site manager
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following hazard is associated with a hydro electrical power plant during operations phase?

I. Defective design, material, specification and/or workmanship
II. Fires in cable galleries, switching rooms, transformers, etc.
III. Explosion or collapse of boilers
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: __________ is an arrangement where liability of the reinsurer is limited up to a certain pre-determined amount of loss, in excess of the amount of loss borne by the ceding company which is known as the Underlying Limit.
e: Correct answer: Excess of loss treaty (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The Industrial All Risks Insurance (IAR) policy is issued by which department in insurance companies?

I. Fire
II. Marine (ENGINEERING)
III. Motor (PROJECT INSURANCE)
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
What is the purpose of conducting a feasibility study of the project?

I. To determine estimated project time
II. To decide workability of the project from various factors relating to physical, economical, environmental and political aspects
III. To determine employment potential to employees
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Arrange the following sections in an engineering insurance policy as per the sequence followed in a standard insurance policy documents.

I. Preamble
II. Heading
III. Attestation clause
e: Correct answer: II, I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Explain the concept of Excess in Contractors All Risk Insurance contracts.
o: The insurer prescribe certain minimum level of excess insurance amounts for different types of perils or losses in CAR insurance
The insurer deducts certain amount from the sum as
The insurer protects itself from certain risk by e
The insurer fixes the claim amount in case of any
The insurer fixes the sum assured at the inception
e: Correct answer: The insurer prescribe certain minimum level of excess insurance amounts for different types of perils or losses in CAR insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In EEI insurance, which of the following sections indemnify the expenses incurred for the purpose of restoring insured external data media, entered in the policy Schedule?

I. Material
II. External data media
III. Increased cost of working
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The Contractors All Risk (CAR) policies only indemnify the loss caused due to the death of a person on a construction site. Argue.
o: CAR policies provide an overall cover for accidental physical loss or damage and ancillary third party liability insurance for a construction project
e: Correct answer: CAR policies provide an overall cover for accidental physical loss or damage and ancillary third party liability insurance for a construction project (from the IC77 question bank).

t: A company in Bangalore manufactures microchips. The company wants to protect itself from financial losses which may occur due to breakdown of its electronic equipment's. Which type of insurance should the company take?
e: Correct answer: Electronic Equipment Insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Sheetal Limited is a manufacturing company. It has taken an electronic equipment insurance for its back office. The management wants to know which of the following losses and damages are exclusions under the EEI policy?

I. Loss or damage to rented equipment
II. Damage of bulbs and lights in office
III. Damage of hard disks due to high humidity
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Under a CECR policy, which of the following perils are excluded from the scope of cover?

I. Willful negligence
II. Contractions due to changes in temperature
III. Inadequate maintenance
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following factors are considered in determining retentions in a reinsurance programme?

I. Size of portfolio
II. Premium rates
III. Probability of loss
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In case a concurrent machinery breakdown insurance policy is also taken along with, deterioration of stock (other than potatoes Potatoes) in cold storage insurance policy, where would the claim for damage be accepted?
o: A claim must be first admitted under the Machinery Insurance Policy before a claim can be accepted under the Stocks Deterioration Policy
A claim must be first admitted under the Stocks De
Based on the option of the insured
e: Correct answer: A claim must be first admitted under the Machinery Insurance Policy before a claim can be accepted under the Stocks Deterioration Policy (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Under a CECR policy, the sum insured is calculated at __________.
o: Lower of historical cost and market value
Lower of historical cost and replacement value
e: Correct answer: Cost of replacement (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
PQR Ltd. wants to calculate the basic rates of premium under a boiler and pressure plant insurance policy. What factors should he consider in computing the same?

I. Type of boiler
II. Type of fuel
III. Owner of boiler
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In the Indian context, ______ of all direct Indian Engineering business, subject to a certain limit, is obligatorily ceded by all the Indian insurance companies to the GIC.
e: Correct answer: 10% (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which section in the engineering insurance policy document gives  name and address of the policy issuing office?
e: Correct answer: Heading (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Suggest ideal fore prevention measures to be adopted at the constriction site.

I. In case the storerooms are not ready, staircase and parking lots may be temporarily used as storage spaces
II. Living quarters should be well separated from the construction site
III.Staircase should be build after the structure of building is ready
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Sanjay wants to take an insurance policy to cover risks due to machinery breakdown. Which cover should he avail?
e: Correct answer: MI insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In MLOP cover, the Turnover during the twelve months immediately before the date of damage is referred to as Annual turnover. Argue. (Choose the most appropriate option.)
o: This statement is wrong as the annual turnover is

t:
Which of the following come in the ambit of engineering insurance?

I. High risks buildings
II. Satellites
III. Electric power stations
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following are principles applicable to all classes of engineering insurance?

I. Utmost good faith
II. Subrogation
III. Retrocession
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

The Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance covers damages caused due to which of the following perils?

I. Human error
II. Landslide
III. Malicious Damage
e: Correct answer: I II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Abhay wants to calculate the sum insured under a Marine Cum Erection (MCE) policy. Details are as follows:- CIF value Rs.5 lakhs Custom duty Rs.1.25 lakhs. Calculate the sum insured under MCE policy.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 6.25 Lakhs (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following damages and losses are exceptions to a machinery insurance policy?

I. Physical damage to the machinery due to short circuit
II. Damage due to insulation of electric conductors
III. Loss of or damage to exchangeable parts and tools such as belts, ropes, chains, dies, moulds
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Treaty insurance may be either on proportional basis or non-proportional basis. Argue. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: This statement is wrong as only facultative insura
This statement is wrong as only proportional basis
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following parties shall be insured under the Comprehensive Project Insurance?

I. Contractors
II. Firms
III. Owner
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ____________ refers to the rate which would have been earned, had the accident not occurred, on the turnover during the Indemnity Period.
e: Correct answer: Rate of gross profit (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Gemini Limited is a software making company. It has taken an electronic equipment insurance for its office. The management wants to know which of the following losses and damages shall be covered under the EEI policy?

I. Loss or damage due to wear and tear of the computer systems
II. Deterioration due to atmospheric conditions
III. Loss or damage due to manufacturer's fault
o: None of I, II and III
e: Correct answer: None of I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

In a deterioration of Stock Insurance Policies, if there is anticipation of serious loss potential, risk should be accepted on basis of:

II. Physical inspection of site by the insurer's representative

A CARinsurance cover shall apply to which of the following structures:

Which among the following uses steam for driving the turbines of power plant?

I. Conventional power plants
II. Hydro electric power plants

Identify the general exclusions in a Contractors All Risk (CAR) insurance policy?

I. Loss or damage due to radioactive contamination
II. Loss due to of malicious damage
